title: Move-Out Checklist for Renters: Handover, Cleaning & Security Deposit in Addis
excerpt: Leave empty property ready for handover: cleaning, minor repairs, keys, meter readings, and timing your movers before the landlord walk-through.
content:
Protect your deposit

In Addis Ababa’s tight rental market, move-out disputes often come down to condition at handover—not whether you hired movers. Coordinate cleaning, truck timing, and the final walk-through in one plan.

Two weeks before

  • Notify landlord or management of move-out date and key return process.
  • Photograph walls, fixtures, and meters with timestamps.
  • Schedule movers for the day before handover when possible—empty rooms photograph cleaner.
  • Confirm whether you must repaint or only patch nail holes per your lease.

Move day

  • Strip hooks, fill small nail holes if required by lease.
  • Remove all items from storage rooms and balconies.
  • Defrost fridge; run final trash down before truck leaves.
  • Keep one “handover kit”: keys, remote controls, spare bulbs, receipts.

After movers leave

Professional cleaning (move-out standard) is often cheaper than deposit deductions. Some clients book movers plus third-party cleaners—we can advise timing so the unit is walk-through ready the morning keys are due.

Condo compounds

Management may inspect common-area damage from lifts—confirm elevator padding rules matched what you used on move day. Lift deposits should be refunded when photos show no new scratches—see condo checklist.

Meters and utilities

Read water and electric meters after the last appliance leaves; send photos to the landlord the same day. Align Ethio telecom or fiber transfer with your move date so you are not billed for the next tenant’s usage.

Month-end overlap

Handover on the 30th collides with elevator rush—book truck and lift before you promise the landlord an exact hour.

Dispute prevention

Email the landlord your move-out photos the same day keys transfer. If management attends walk-through, sign only after noting any disagreements on the checklist form—not verbally “we’ll fix later.”
